status: preproduction authored: none of the new LUE/LUR/LUQ physical scenes, flags or assets has been implemented or verified in Unreal
design_intent: living-world nuance, physical exploration, optional humane microquests, local knowledge boundaries, and a repeatable asset/QA handoff layered on canonical quests
authority: Source/TheUnmadeGame original quest and save rules

universal_rules.progression: All LUR/LUE/LUQ content is optional and never a hidden main-story, boss, realm-travel or earned-rite prerequisite. No new source SaveGame fields exist for these specs.
universal_rules.evidence: Inspectable clues require a visible physical verb, proximity/line-of-sight and readable alternatives. A spoken line never impersonates a source quest completion.
universal_rules.personal_knowledge: A resident has only witnessed, personally told, or legitimately public local facts. Remote-region news requires visible dated courier delivery and never turns rumors into personal observations.
universal_rules.choices: Each LUQ ending is mutually exclusive within that side quest, shown as two explicit consequences before the six-second confirm interaction; defer actual save schema to implemented isolated versioned state.
universal_rules.rollback: On failed write restore the entire prior state; no physical changes, inventory duplication or reported success until durable commit.
universal_rules.failure: No clue permanently consumed by a wrong attempt. Environmental danger provides telegraph, credible escape and restart near evidence, rather than repetition of long dialogue.
universal_rules.accessibility: All cues have independent visual and caption/text signals; motion-reduced and static-horizon mode, remappable controls, reading time, subtitle speaker, high contrast and color-blind differentiation.
universal_rules.ending: Held Morning and Many Mornings preserve existing quests, personhood, inventory and visit history; shown changes are local public facts, not fabricated universal eyewitness knowledge.
universal_rules.content_status: Production guidance only: all scene triggers, optional side-quest save slots, new resident actions, art IDs and dialogue require implementation and Editor acceptance.

worlds.title: The Threefold Reach
worlds.ordinary: Refuge kettles are counted before wages; Bellwold lantern tenders walk the same lane that Paperhaven record runners insist never existed.
worlds.architecture: A three-way road knot of mismatched mile markers, split-roof shelters, chalk archive vaults and a bell tower missing its casting seam.
worlds.custom: A visitor is offered a place to sit before a request for a name; recording a stranger's name without consent is considered a quiet theft.
worlds.taboo: Never ring a bell during the interval reserved for those no ledger can verify.
worlds.governance: Shelter stewards negotiate resources with archive registrars; neither holds authority over the other's witnesses.
worlds.labor: Lantern wick trimming, route repair, water carting, archive copying and informal shelter kitchens.
worlds.trade: Measured lantern oil, copied route notes and shelter meal tokens; no reward for registering a displaced person's private name.
worlds.ecology: Pale waymoss grows toward walked paths, not sunlight; little paper-wings nest where contradictory maps overlap.
worlds.weather: The day's shadow agrees with the road until the missing bell note; during the interval only the mile markers disagree.

sensory.day: Wet paper and kettle steam; boot soles on mismatched paving; warm pockets of lantern gold.
sensory.night: Shelter fires persist; a bell's absent final note lowers the ambience without producing sudden full silence.
sensory.hazard_cue: Route splits acquire high-contrast chalk edging before the safe way changes.
sensory.access: Persistent map and text clue; bell silence is also indicated by visible wick tremor and caption.

mystery.question: How can a refuge be remembered and officially never built?
mystery.visible: A shelter hearth has more soot than the building's documented age.

evidence.verb: Compare the mold rim with the tower's missing casting seam
evidence.discovery: Metal never poured; indentations show hands holding a bell-shaped void.

evidence.verb: Align a refugee meal chit with a registry's blank date
evidence.discovery: The receipt predates the legal approval yet bears the same worn thumbmark.

evidence.verb: Follow a child's chalk route against a surveyor's stone mile
evidence.discovery: Both lead to the same kettle house from opposing directions.

mystery.false_lead: The archivist burned a page; investigation shows an old fire unrelated to the missing date.
mystery.interpretation: The interval was socially necessary before it was made official; neither ledger nor testimony can erase the people sheltered.
mystery.link: A rain-soaked meal chit carries an imprint of Saltwake's older harbor tariff.
mystery.hint: The child's chalk crosses the road only when the bell stops.
mystery.do_not_reveal: Do not mention Nhal-Vey or a final boss by name.

worlds.title: The Widowed Rain
worlds.ordinary: Dry-dock families mend nets for a sea absent from maps; public rain catchers are checked before any ferry launches.
worlds.architecture: Hull-roof shelters, tide gauges anchored in dry stone, sloped breakwaters and an open storm sluice court.
worlds.custom: People greet strangers by offering a dry knot of rope rather than a handshake; a knot accepted means safe shelter, not ownership.
worlds.taboo: No one claims to own another family's collected rain by reading a debt aloud in a storm.
worlds.governance: Harbor wardens hold flood authority; navigators challenge them with physical measurements and common rain counters.
worlds.labor: Net darning, empty buoy inspection, slate-chart repair, storm-shelter watch and ferry maintenance.
worlds.trade: Rain allotments and ferry repair credits; storm insurance cannot be collected twice on the same missing tide.
worlds.ecology: Salt fern clings to dry piers; tidecrabs hide below no-water marks and emerge with loud pressure shifts.
worlds.weather: Rain has weight and rhythm without a reachable sea; the storm pulse telegraphs on marked lanes with a safe elevated bypass.

sensory.day: Blue rust, wet rope, slate ticking beneath a missing waterline.
sensory.night: Empty buoy chime has no splash; rain lamp halos stretch toward impossible offshore distance.
sensory.hazard_cue: A low rail vibrates, sluice counter flashes blue and the storm lane glows before impact.
sensory.access: Visual counter, captioned pressure click and high-contrast elevated safe line, never audio-only.

mystery.question: Who wrote a tariff for a harbor that disappeared before the tariff's issuer was born?
mystery.visible: A buoy ledger records departures from dry ground.

evidence.verb: Touch three tide grooves and mark which groove is newer than the post
evidence.discovery: The newest groove lies beneath a mark carved centuries earlier.

evidence.verb: Read numbers only after the storm warning has settled
evidence.discovery: The last tally includes a negative arrival not charged to any fisher.

evidence.verb: Fit an older rope knot to a measured missing-buoy hole
evidence.discovery: A net repair tag from Drevlach lists the same impossible date.

mystery.false_lead: A missing boat was stolen; the inspected sail seams reveal it never touched this shore.
mystery.interpretation: A vanished channel was made useful as transferable future debt; residents still must decide fair access to real rain.
mystery.link: The negative arrival is charged to a child's future birth in Drevlach.
mystery.hint: Read the public counter in the lull, not while running from the warning.
mystery.do_not_reveal: Do not frame all debtors as villains or reveal final enemy.

worlds.title: The Hearth Beneath
worlds.ordinary: Households share a public heat allowance without agreeing who originally lit the flame; the heat vent is inspected before breakfast.
worlds.architecture: Sunken communal kilns, basalt house ribs, ash sieves and a vent court whose shadows disagree with its fire.
worlds.custom: Offering a cooled coal signals willingness to listen rather than consent to repay a family obligation.
worlds.taboo: Never attribute another person's warmth to inherited debt without hearing that household.
worlds.governance: Kiln guild weighs public safety; hearth readers hold independent records of each fuel claim.
worlds.labor: Clay tempering, vent grating, stone-lid casting, communal bread baking and ash sorting.
worlds.trade: Cooled ceramic, workshop hours and public vent shares; heat claims are witnesses, not currency for buying people.
worlds.ecology: Glass moths fold their wings near unsafe heat; ash root threads retain warmth long after fire goes dark.
worlds.weather: Borrowed sun glow rises from beneath streets; source heat pulses give a legible orange warning and signed refuge route.

sensory.day: Basalt dust, fermented dough, slow metal ping from vent housings.
sensory.night: Coals cast a second wrong-way shadow across floor tiles.
sensory.hazard_cue: Vent shutters chatter and floor seams brighten before danger.
sensory.access: Shutter silhouettes and text hazard timer accompany sound; no photo-flash requirement.

mystery.question: Why does a hearth cast warmth from an hour nobody lived?
mystery.visible: An ash register shows the kiln burning before any fuel receipt.

evidence.verb: Compare wear on two teeth without engaging hazardous mechanism
evidence.discovery: The wheel has been wound one turn before its manufacture stamp.

evidence.verb: Lift a cooled ash pan after its safety indicator
evidence.discovery: Unburned paper inside describes a childhood that has not yet occurred.

evidence.verb: Align shadow scratches with a real lantern
evidence.discovery: A missing beat matches the choir pauses of Orravane.

mystery.false_lead: A guild master deliberately lit all fires; the mark predates the guild and is acknowledged by its critics.
mystery.interpretation: Survival is being subsidized by an unasked temporal obligation that ordinary citizens did not individually choose.
mystery.link: The impossible pause in flame is mirrored by a missing sustaining note in Orravane.
mystery.hint: Wait for the ash pan's cooled edge; the safe clue outlasts the pulse.
mystery.do_not_reveal: No pre-Auvren speech may confirm Nhal-Vey's creation.

routine.action: Carry a clay loaf tray between counters rather than through live vent corridor

routine.feedback: Second shadow marks a clue in soot
routine.failure: Tray cools if delayed; no permanent penalty
routine.recovery: Return to the oven, collect fresh warm tray, and use obvious sheltered route
routine.persistence: Optional ambient scene; never converts into debt

routine.action: Listen to two opposed household accounts before selecting public record format
routine.reaction: Hearth reader keeps disagreement visible but does not announce a single winner
routine.line: We can owe the flame care without owing it ourselves.
routine.feedback: Public display changes commentary only, does not overwrite earlier choice
routine.failure: If a household refuses a name, only anonymized account is readable
routine.persistence: One codex variant per choice; no local story reset

worlds.title: The Sea of Written Debts
worlds.ordinary: Children learn to count tide-ledger stamps before they learn genealogies; grown debt carriers argue whether future entries are valid.
worlds.architecture: Ledger canals, inkstone lockhouses, portable counting bridges and thresholds etched with dates not yet reached.
worlds.custom: A contract offered to a traveler must be read both forwards and backwards; silence is not acceptance.
worlds.taboo: Do not assign a future child's signature to an adult's current hardship.
worlds.governance: Counter-clerks control public transit slips; debt dissidents keep receipts in an unlicensed dry archive.
worlds.labor: Ink harvesting, sluice scribing, canal tow, account witnesses and slip repair.
worlds.trade: Repair vouchers and witnessed labor credits; speculative birth collateral is an institutional abuse, not a valid player currency.
worlds.ecology: Date-eels gather by inkstone sluices one moment before rain; ink reeds bloom with letters running the wrong direction.
worlds.weather: Water follows recorded debits in some canals; nearby tide surge has readable boundaries and a safe bank.

sensory.day: Ink brine, paper scraping over stone, regular tapping from canal clocks.
sensory.night: Ledger lamps shine through reversed dates on translucent water.
sensory.hazard_cue: Debt tide pulls paper flags against their stakes before collision pressure.
sensory.access: Tactile marker relief and high-contrast arrows identify safe banks; written equivalents to number sounds.

mystery.question: Who can own a debt dated before its debtor exists?
mystery.visible: A child's future signature appears in a ledger sealed while the child was unborn.

evidence.verb: Make one non-binding rubbing of reversed embossed entries
evidence.discovery: Debit appears before the credit on both impressions.

evidence.verb: Place a Saltwake repair tag beside a birth-date tab
evidence.discovery: The missing sea's tariff was securitized as someone's unwritten years.

evidence.verb: Watch water change direction at an unoccupied account post
evidence.discovery: The canal still serves a debt whose witness cannot be found.

mystery.false_lead: The child is secretly an immortal debtor; no evidence supports this, and the story must not confirm it.
mystery.interpretation: Contracts became infrastructure; an accounting system exploited questions no one dared demand answered.
mystery.link: An erased family reference in the dry archive points toward Vathless stone deeds.
mystery.hint: The two stamps must be read in opposite directions.
mystery.do_not_reveal: The final entity is not the bank manager and debt exploitation remains a civic choice.

routine.action: Witness a purchase without signing and compare a forged balance slip to a merchant's spoken price

routine.line: There is a difference between balancing a book and balancing a life.
routine.feedback: Slip shows an impossible offset only if physically held against light
routine.failure: Wrong slip is returned without a fine
routine.recovery: Ask for duplicate public copy and inspect again

routine.action: Escort an older counter-clerk by a safe bank as dates glow in the canal
routine.reaction: The clerk can admit personal guilt without erasing neighbors' survival needs
routine.line: I filed the number. I did not make the child.
routine.feedback: Public plaque acknowledges local committed outcome
routine.recovery: Use signed upper bank, no escort permadeath
routine.persistence: Single optional witnessed meeting; no currency duplication

Compare a dry archive tag with a witness clerk's original

worlds.title: The Upside-Down Choir
worlds.ordinary: Suspended houses are serviced by singers who must rest; nobody agrees whether the missing choir note is a worker or a building support.
worlds.architecture: Inverted terraces, hanging floors, counterweight choirs and bridges pinned by acoustic chambers.
worlds.custom: Visitors tap a support rail before speaking so residents can tell a body from an echo.
worlds.taboo: No one is required to sing past exhaustion to earn shelter; dissenting silence is a valid testimony.
worlds.governance: Bridge wardens and choir stewards dispute who may interrupt load-bearing performances.
worlds.labor: Resonance tending, rope weighing, breath-rest scheduling, tuning-hammer repair and hanging-garden care.
worlds.trade: Repair parts, rest shifts and verified safe-path charts; voices are not tradable property.
worlds.ecology: Ceiling swifts nest beneath streets; air lichen curls when load-bearing intervals weaken.
worlds.weather: Inverted choir draft disorients briefly but warning rails and a fully safe sideline remain reliable.

sensory.day: A low resonant seam under wooden rail taps; dangling soil falls upward.
sensory.night: The unoccupied singer's platform hums while all visible throats rest.
sensory.hazard_cue: Support-rail beads tremble before pressure interval; stable colored cue persists without audio.
sensory.access: Subtitles identify note direction; alternative static horizon and rail pulse support vestibular accessibility.

mystery.question: Who should be allowed to stop singing when the missing note holds up homes?
mystery.visible: An unused score stand supports a terrace with no musician present.

evidence.verb: Examine a scratched rest tally under the score
evidence.discovery: A seventh resting interval appears between six singers.

evidence.verb: Compare load changes during marked safe chorus breaks
evidence.discovery: The bridge carries an absent weight instead of failing.

evidence.verb: Read an account only after asking the resting singer
evidence.discovery: Consent to perform was treated as permanent once spoken.

mystery.false_lead: The singers freely enjoy endless work; several expressly deny this, others find meaning in singing.
mystery.interpretation: The absence physically stabilizes a community but cannot justify continuing compelled labor.
mystery.link: The missing interval is the same impossible beat recorded in Cinderhold's hearth slate.
mystery.hint: When the rail beads stop, the lectern can be approached on solid ground.
mystery.do_not_reveal: Do not make musicians metaphysical batteries that disappear after rescue.

routine.feedback: The chosen public bridge state stays visible on reload
routine.failure: Unsupported bridge yields a safe retreat not a lethal trap
routine.recovery: Use lower rail and repeat with no inventory loss

worlds.title: The Bones of Yesterdays
worlds.ordinary: Stonecutters repair homes built from inherited names; children trace rejected family trees under the quarry shelter.
worlds.architecture: Ancestral quarry shelves, family-wall dwellings, layered stone ledgers and roots hardened into civic stairs.
worlds.custom: Before shaping a family stone, ask whose name is already inside it; refusal to answer is not proof of ownership.
worlds.taboo: Breaking a bearing stone to make a moral point is forbidden while people live above it.
worlds.governance: Stone stewards prioritize structural safety; remembrance guild advocates for unrecorded families.
worlds.labor: Mortar grinding, brace repair, name-rubbing, quarry dust screening and foundation surveying.
worlds.trade: Measured safe stone, repair labor and open memorial casts; no sale of another family's deleted ancestry.
worlds.ecology: Name lichens distinguish quarry strata by remembered footsteps; stone swallows circle just before shelf fracture.
worlds.weather: Dry law-root pressure cracks the quarry with visible fracture lines; marked side shelter stays safe.

sensory.day: Granite powder, cold damp air, chisel echoes too long for the gallery.
sensory.night: Faint household names emerge in low angled light along the stairs.
sensory.hazard_cue: Bright chalk lines widen and gravel rattles before a shelf split.
sensory.access: High contrast cracks, dust-resistant camera, low-frequency captions; no invisible collapse.

mystery.question: How many generations can a house erase and still call itself ancestral?
mystery.visible: A bearing stone has a worked child-sized handprint below a false founding date.

evidence.verb: Brush dust from mismatched chisels without weakening support
evidence.discovery: An older family name survives beneath a legally new stone seal.

evidence.verb: Compare one inhabited dwelling's weight ledger to its family roll
evidence.discovery: The building is supported by stone attributed to a person never listed.

evidence.verb: Hold a rubbing to angled lantern light
evidence.discovery: Drevlach's account mark appears where a birth record was removed.

mystery.false_lead: A whole civilization knowingly killed its ancestors; records show disputed incremental decisions over generations.
mystery.interpretation: Injustice has become load-bearing architecture; repair demands engineering and witness consent, not demolition.
mystery.link: Missing quarry birth marks correlate with Drevlach's speculative debt stamps.
mystery.hint: The quieter stair at night reveals the lower inscription.
mystery.do_not_reveal: A name revealed by Glimpse is evidence, not automatic consent to publish it.

routine.recovery: Retain a private rubbing or request authorized public summary
routine.persistence: Optional codex; no forced story overwrite

worlds.title: The Hundred Unlived
worlds.ordinary: People without authorized birth records teach each other how to build legitimate homes; a visitor's first meal is never conditioned on identity papers.
worlds.architecture: Overlapping doorstep grids, unsigned household lamps, reversible street signs and a civic refuge woven from contradictory addresses.
worlds.custom: A name is given once as a gift and may be withdrawn; people call each other by agreed gestures when uncertain.
worlds.taboo: Never count a person aloud without permission; counting can become conscription or forced recognition.
worlds.governance: Shelter pairs and census refusals negotiate practical care; no single municipal count can define personhood.
worlds.labor: House-number weaving, lamp repair, garden tending, route witnessing and voluntary address translation.
worlds.trade: Portable lamp repairs, shared garden portions and voluntary address stamps; names are never accepted as payment.
worlds.ecology: Unlived moths emerge where two paths intersect, and inkless ivy flowers in the shade of unsigned doors.
worlds.weather: Census pulses create nonlethal reality strain at marked checkpoints; sheltered routes avoid involuntary counting.

sensory.day: Two door knocks one heartbeat apart; herb smoke and lamplight beneath sunny thresholds.
sensory.night: Street numbers glow as gestures, never an exact authoritative sequence.
sensory.hazard_cue: A census arch displays a visible expanding lattice before pressure.
sensory.access: Consent dialogue text, signed alternate paths and static-address map; no forced spoken names.

mystery.question: Can someone have a lived history even when no birth record admits them?
mystery.visible: A kitchen stool wears down beneath a wall that officially describes an empty lot.

evidence.verb: Weave a visible non-identifying directional knot
evidence.discovery: A guest's address exists as a route even when a registry refuses the person's name.

evidence.verb: Compare seat repair stitches with the blank occupancy sheet
evidence.discovery: Years of communal repair predate the authorized household.

evidence.verb: Ask permission to read a voluntary public testimony
evidence.discovery: One person's chosen identity is not reducible to a census count.

mystery.false_lead: The residents are ghost copies; direct care, work and memory establish present lives without origin certainty.
mystery.interpretation: Recognition cannot be coerced as the price of existence; unknown origin is not absence of rights.
mystery.link: The unclaimed oath syntax is shared with Tharniv's unwritten crown petitions.
mystery.hint: Ask at the threshold before touching the public testimony.
mystery.do_not_reveal: Never expose a real character's chosen private name through spell effects without consent.

routine.action: Find a missing water bowl by following voluntary house gestures instead of numbering people
routine.reaction: A neighbor thanks the player for asking for directions, not identity
routine.line: You can find my door. That is enough for breakfast.
routine.feedback: Three location gestures mark safe path
routine.failure: A guessed address brings player to a polite wrong door
routine.persistence: Codex learns gesture only; no mandatory counting

routine.action: Help illuminate a route that can be followed without naming a resident
routine.reaction: Shelter witness explains what public knowledge is and isn't allowed
routine.line: A path belongs to feet, not to a registry.
routine.feedback: New signed footpath is visible without changing main atlas locks
routine.failure: Involuntary census arch refuses entry via safe bypass
routine.recovery: Take alternate loom street; still sees same story

side.name: The Unnumbered Door
side.objective: Make a guest route legible without forcing residents into the census
steps: Find a lost courier using two public directional gestures
Ask two hosts independently how they want travelers guided
Collect lamp glass from an unoccupied repair stand
Set lamps along an alternate marked alley
Choose anonymous shared wayfinding or opt-in address plaques

branches.care: Gestural wayfinding guides guests without personal census.
branches.truth: Opt-in plaques allow public identification where consent exists.

side.failure: An invalid address knocks at the wrong door without escalating hostility.
side.recovery: Return to the public loom, learn gesture order and retry.
side.return_dialogue: The guest reached our door without knowing our names. We chose to open it.
side.save: New optional contract; no personal census registry implemented

post.held: One visible route honors people whether or not their names become public.
post.many: Multiple address geometries remain passable with clearly chosen static guide mode.

worlds.title: The Orchard of Unwritten Kings
worlds.ordinary: Families tend grafted trees whose fruits are subject to laws never enacted; petitions grow on branches rather than sitting on a throne.
worlds.architecture: Grafted civic orchards, paper-bark meeting rings, unoccupied crown plinths and root roads fenced by polite petitions.
worlds.custom: A petitioner leaves one fruit untouched to represent the person absent from the hearing.
worlds.taboo: No outsider may crown another person by praise alone; the empty throne is not a secret boss weakness.
worlds.governance: Rotating orchard circles interpret inherited rules; nobody can claim the absent monarch's exclusive mandate.
worlds.labor: Root pruning, petition sorting, harvest weighing, branch grafting and shade-road maintenance.
worlds.trade: Fruit pledges, tool repair and public harvest exchanges; laws cannot be bought as loot.
worlds.ecology: Law roots twist toward unsigned petitions; double-orchard bees pollinate both unchosen grafts.
worlds.weather: Enforcement roots visibly lift ground before restraining a lane; marked path skirts pressure safely.

sensory.day: Overripe orchard peel, dry petition paper, creaking boughs like seating benches.
sensory.night: Empty plinth throws a crown-shaped shadow while no crown exists.
sensory.hazard_cue: Roots announce their line by raised dirt and fluttering leaves before contact.
sensory.access: Stable canopy view and ground markers; clue readings available as plain text.

mystery.question: Why does an unwritten decree decide who may eat?
mystery.visible: A branch knots itself around a petition whose author never signed.

evidence.verb: Compare its dust and shadow without taking an imagined crown
evidence.discovery: The empty shape is a social expectation, not proof of a hidden ruler.

evidence.verb: Weigh a rejected apple beside one publicly allocated
evidence.discovery: Fruit responds to a rule nobody can locate in a signed vote.

evidence.verb: Read two mutually incompatible but still in-force petitions
evidence.discovery: An Eillun address has been denied harvest access despite no legal judgment.

mystery.false_lead: The crown is cursed by a single necromancer; every petition demonstrates communal complicity instead.
mystery.interpretation: A society delegated responsibility to a law whose legitimacy was never examined; removing a tyrant alone cannot change habits.
mystery.link: One denied petition's route gestures match Eillun's consent-based addresses.
mystery.hint: Leave the untouched fruit on the scale until both records are visible.
mystery.do_not_reveal: Never turn the empty throne into proof of a preselected royal bloodline.

routine.trigger: player enters Tharniv before local trial
routine.action: Use a public scale to sort split-graft fruit without claiming an automatic title
routine.reaction: Orchard worker asks which household has the right to refuse an obligation
routine.line: An apple doesn't ask who wrote the law that weighs it.
routine.feedback: A second graft shadow reveals readable petition under bark
routine.failure: Picking forbidden fruit triggers a verbal challenge, not irreversible faction hostility
routine.recovery: Return fruit to tray; inspect petition and scale

routine.action: Observe two residents argue a petition under crown-shaped shadow
routine.reaction: No actor pretends the unseen monarch has personally spoken
routine.line: The law survived its author. Perhaps it never had one.
routine.feedback: Later public marker respects committed civic outcome
routine.recovery: Read daytime posted petition to find night meeting schedule

side.name: The Fruit Left Untouched
side.objective: Permit harvest access without crowning anyone or deleting a dissenting petition
steps: Find the unsigned harvest prohibition under petition bark
Hear a grower and a nonresident claimant with conflicting histories
Balance fruit on an existing mechanical public scale
Carry a graft token through the law-root safe path
Choose a common harvest table or an open petition hearing with consent safeguards

branches.care: Common table feeds visitors without invoking an unchosen ruler.
branches.truth: Public hearing lists actual legal decisions and preserves dissent.

side.failure: Scale tips if fruit is moved too soon; no fictional invisible guilt counter.
side.recovery: Reset physical balance and reweigh with both tokens.
side.return_dialogue: The fruit fed someone. Nobody had to wear the crown.
side.save: Optional quest, authority remains original orchard progression

post.held: Old petitions remain etched as scars on one stable public harvest table.
post.many: Two harvest practices can coexist, explicitly marked rather than phasing players without notice.

worlds.title: The Place Before Place
worlds.ordinary: Travelers maintain markers to departures they never made; witnesses debate whether a threshold can be a home rather than a test.
worlds.architecture: Northern witness plateau, two founding thresholds, limestone rooms containing their own outside, and an open arena built from public testimony.
worlds.custom: When someone asks where you come from, it is polite to answer what you choose to carry, not what blood says.
worlds.taboo: Never require a traveler to complete a private guardian challenge before they may leave the place.
worlds.governance: No crown or registered state; witnesses curate openly contested entry accounts and a stable public exit.
worlds.labor: Path chalking, lamp tending, worn step repair, witness listening and maintaining the northern passage.
worlds.trade: Repair supplies and harmless collected inscriptions; entry to the final path is not purchasable.
worlds.ecology: Threshold moths gather at doors opened from both sides; origin stones cool in reverse sunset order.
worlds.weather: Horizon folds over the northern witness land; a legible stable path never disappears with optional effects.

sensory.day: Air without echo, chalk dust, daylight seemingly arriving from the destination.
sensory.night: Two distant sunrise tones are perceptible as distinct illuminated bands even with audio muted.
sensory.hazard_cue: A threshold line draws outward before collision rules change, with explicit stable marker.
sensory.access: Static-horizon option, reduced distortion, clear route text and no reversed physical controls.

mystery.question: How can a person arrive before any world grants them a birthplace?
mystery.visible: A worn footprint points toward an entry gate that was built after the footprint formed.

evidence.verb: Compare the player's present footfall with older mark without using personal profile
evidence.discovery: The earlier mark is possible without choosing a predetermined ancestry.

evidence.verb: Listen to both testimony markers in either order
evidence.discovery: The accounts contradict without either requiring immediate erasure.

evidence.verb: Inspect a stable exit line before opting into the arena
evidence.discovery: Auvren can hold open a question without paying with someone's life.

mystery.false_lead: The first witness is the creator of the player and therefore may command them; source only supports a remembered impossible arrival.
mystery.interpretation: The protagonist's shared impossible origin grants no unilateral right to overwrite other lives; the confrontation is about inherited responsibility.
mystery.link: Both witnesses echo the Bellwold interval without explaining away ordinary civic injustice.
mystery.hint: The witnesses can be visited in either order; follow marked northern safe line.
mystery.do_not_reveal: Do not spoil mask-breaking or two mornings in the public first-arrival dialogue.

routine.action: Replace one extinguished lamp glass before questioning a waiting witness
routine.reaction: Witness speaks as an individual who noticed only the player's entry, not all past choices
routine.line: You came here before you came here. I cannot tell you what that makes you.
routine.feedback: Old footprint acquires a separate visible cast shadow
routine.failure: Wrong lamp glass only refracts light; no fake ancestral choice
routine.recovery: Swap with correctly etched glass from adjacent shelf

routine.trigger: Auvren first chapter done and main boss gate true
routine.action: Choose to sit and read two incompatible witness accounts before entering northern arena
routine.reaction: Witness offers information but refuses to assign final moral ending
routine.line: Do not ask me which first day happened. Ask who survived each.
routine.feedback: Optional context without additional gate or reward
routine.failure: Player can ignore dialogue and take same accessible boss route
routine.recovery: Read public placards at any time
routine.persistence: No prerequisite flag; original FinalJourney remains authoritative

side.name: A Mark for Leaving
side.unlock: after Auvren first trial; optional before or after ending
side.objective: Create a reliable public return marker without deciding everyone's first origin
steps: Find the older departure footprint on the southern step
Hear each public witness in any order
Collect a safe chalk lens from the lamp stand
Place it on a public exit rather than a locked private arena door
Choose a single stable marker or visibly paired route markers; preserve safe exit

branches.care: One legible public exit arrow remains regardless of future ending.
branches.truth: Paired departure accounts are posted together with a stable navigation overlay.

side.failure: Choosing an arena-only wall is refused and the chalk lens is returned.
side.recovery: Use the signed public steps and try either branch again before commitment.
side.return_dialogue: A way out is not a verdict about where we began.
side.save: Separate optional LUQ contract, cannot mark boss defeated or FinalJourney state

post.held: A single public exit keeps old contradiction readable in footnote markers.
post.many: Paired thresholds remain equally navigable; static single-line guidance is available.

cross_realm_mystery.theme: The Unanswered Interval was institutionalized differently by each society. Evidence can disagree without people being liars.

cross_realm_mystery.final_reveal_policy: Nhal-Vey's mask fracture, unmasked battle, two futures, and voluntary echo are never spoiled in arrival material. Auvren witness phrasing may foreshadow contradictions without revealing the final choices.
puzzle_hints: First voluntary hint after 60 seconds of meaningful stalled interaction: identify nearby physical evidence category.
Second voluntary hint after 120 seconds: name the precise safe location and required observable action.
Third voluntary hint after 180 seconds: explain the non-spoiler action order without auto-solving; all tiers optional and reset per puzzle.
cross_realm_mystery.presentation_budget: No claims of sound, animation, full performance or polished art. All identifiers denote new work packages, not existing assets.
